actual.content:
1. The domestic meal allowance per travel day is 73 credits [doc1].

2. The annual learning allowance is 640 credits [doc2].

3. Employees may work remotely two days each week [doc3].

4. Completed equipment calibration records are retained for seven years [doc4].

5. Shared field sensors must be calibrated every 90 calendar days [doc5].

6. Travel claims must be submitted within 21 calendar days of returning [doc1], whereas learning reimbursement claims must be submitted within 45 calendar days of course completion [doc2].

7. There is insufficient evidence about an orbital relocation allowance in the provided policies.
